outcome: Salbutamol inhaler prescription at age 5 years
cohort: 321,287 term singleton first-born offspring born in Scotland, United Kingdom, between 1993 and 2007
finding: Planned cesarean delivery, compared with vaginal delivery, was associated with a small absolute increased risk of asthma requiring hospital admission, salbutamol inhaler prescription at age 5 years, and all-cause death by age 21 years.
mod_finding: Compared with offspring born by unscheduled cesarean delivery, those born by planned cesarean delivery were at no significantly different risk of asthma requiring hospital admission, salbutamol inhaler prescription at age 5 years, obesity at age 5 years, inflammatory bowel disease, cancer, or death but were at increased risk of type 1 diabetes.
